requirements.title: IEEE_REM argument restrictions
requirements.definition: The IEEE_REM arguments shall be real and have the same radix.

pending.IEEE_REM-arguments-real: Positive source controls probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(4.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(3.0), and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(2.0) before invoking IEEE_REM(4.0,3.0) and IEEE_REM(3.0,2.0) with real X and Y. Source-control mutation uses integer or complex actuals and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.IEEE_REM-arguments-same-radix: Positive source control probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(4.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(3.0), verifies RADIX(4.0)==RADIX(3.0), then invokes IEEE_REM(4.0,3.0). requirements.title: IEEE_REM finite nonzero operands use exact nearest-even remainder
requirements.definition: For finite X and nonzero finite Y, IEEE_REM returns exactly X - Y*N with N nearest to X/Y and ties choosing even N; zero results have the sign of X.

pending.IEEE_REM-tie-chooses-even-N: Guarded branch probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(3.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(2.0) before the call; supported branch asserts IEEE_REM(3.0,2.0)==-1.0 because X/Y=1.5 selects even N=2. Mutation expects +1.0.
